column1: # Known screens and the goldens each one is expected to have. The gallery groups every golden under the first row whose most specific
# pattern matches it, and lists each row whose expected golden is missing under "Not covered".
# Columns, separated by tabs: module (app or lumio), screen id, title, expected golden names. A name ending in * matches any golden that
# starts with the text before the *. The screen id is the golden prefix that the scenario label drops, so "bulk_generate_ready" shows as "ready".
# Composables that only wrap another screen (the *Route functions) are not rows; the screen they wrap is.
